title: Using SegFormer for Effective Semantic Cell Segmentation for Fault Detection in Photovoltaic Arrays
mechanism: SegFormer (hierarchical transformer encoder + all-MLP decoder) for EL defect segmentation; beat CNN segmenters on UCF-EL.
adaptation: MiT-B2/B3 with ADE20K weights, 1-ch stem, 512 px; add a full-res conv skip before the head because SegFormer predicts at 1/4 resolution; lower encoder lr (PF-style).
min_experiment: Arm SegFormer-B2 + full-res skip, 3-seed screen vs house; mIoU_rob, crack relF1@2, E1 crack recall; kill if all three below house.
evidence: R: UCF-EL 5 classes; pixel acc 96.24%, weighted F1 96.22%, unweighted F1 81.96%, mIoU 56.54%, above DeepLabv3, U-Net, DeepLabv3+, PAN, PSPNet, FPN.
